title: Turbo Harness: Instance-Adaptive Harness Optimization
title_zh: Turbo Harness：实例自适应执行框架优化

paragraphs.en: Automating the search for effective harnesses is an important step toward enabling agents to recursively self-improve. Existing harness optimizations typically produce a single global harness that is applied uniformly across task instances. However, a harness that works well on average may not be optimal for every instance. We introduce Turbo Harness , a framework that can adapt a globally optimized harness to each instance by reusing information generated during the original optimization process. Specifically, Turbo Harness recycles artifacts produced during a completed global harness optimization run, and summarizes them into a structured playbook. We train a harness editor to leverage this prior optimization experience to generate instance-specific patches to the global harness. At inference time, the editor uses the instance and the playbook to construct a tailored harness in which the execution model operates. Through numerical experiments, we show that Turbo Harness consistently outperforms existing harness optimization baselines across seven benchmarks spanning interactive agent tasks, software engineering, and long-horizon terminal tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化地寻找有效的 harness 是使智能体能够递归自我改进的重要一步。 现有的 harness 优化方法通常会产生一个全局性的 harness，并统一应用于所有任务实例。 然而，在平均表现良好的 harness 可能并非每个实例的最优选择。 我们提出了 Turbo Harness——一个框架，它可以通过复用原始优化过程中生成的信息，将全局优化的 harness 适配到每个具体实例。 具体来说，Turbo Harness 会回收已完成的全局 harness 优化运行中产生的产物，并将其总结为结构化的执行方案。 我们训练了一个 harness 编辑器，使其能够利用这些先前的优化经验，为每个实例生成针对全局 harness 的特定补丁。 在推理阶段，该编辑器会结合具体实例和执行方案，构建一个定制化的 harness，供执行模型在其中运行。 通过数值实验，我们证明 Turbo Harness 在涵盖交互式智能体任务、软件工程和长期终端任务的七个基准测试中，始终优于现有的 harness 优化基线方法。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) and their surrounding harnesses are two fundamental building blocks of modern agents ( Tian et al., 2026 ) . The notion of a harness has expanded well beyond simply exposing an LLM to an environment or a collection of tools ( Yao et al., 2022b ) . Today, it encompasses nearly all of the runtime machinery surrounding the model (e.g., context management, memory, workflow orchestration, and verification) ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Zhong and Zhu, 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . These mechanisms can substantially extend the effective capabilities of a static LLM, particularly on long-horizon, scientific, and open-ended tasks ( Ma et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . At the same time, this broad definition creates an enormous design space: for an application of interest, one must decide what information to expose to the model, what state to maintain, when and how to intervene, and how much computation to allocate. Designing an effective harness is therefore a challenging optimization problem in its own right.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）及其周围的配套机制是现代智能体的两个基本构建模块（Tian 等，2026）。 “配套机制”这一概念已远远超越了仅仅将 LLM 暴露于环境或工具集之外的简单范畴（Yao 等，2022b）。 如今，它几乎涵盖了模型周围的所有运行时机制（例如上下文管理、记忆、工作流协调和验证）（Huang 等，2026；Zhong 和 Zhu，2026；Zhou 等，2026）。 这些机制能够显著提升静态 LLM 的实际能力，尤其是在长期规划、科学探索以及开放性问题任务中（Ma 等，2026；Wu 等，2026）。 与此同时，这种宽泛的定义也创造了一个巨大的设计空间：对于某个特定应用，必须决定向模型暴露哪些信息、维持何种状态、何时以及如何介入，以及分配多少计算资源。 因此，设计一个高效的配套机制本身就是一个极具挑战性的优化问题。

paragraphs.en: A growing line of work seeks to automate this process through harness optimization ( Anthropic, 2025a ; Lee et al., 2026b ; Lee et al., 2026a ) . For example, Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026b ) adopts an outer-loop program-search approach, in which a separate agent proposes new harnesses based on the execution traces of previously evaluated candidates; Harness-R1 ( Shao et al., 2026 ) trains a harness engineer with reinforcement learning (RL) to transform batches of agent failures into executable runtime patches. Despite their promise, existing approaches have two limitations. First, they optimize a single global harness that is then applied uniformly across all, or a batch of, test instances. Yet a harness that is effective for one instance may be suboptimal for another. For example, SWE-Bench-style instances may come from different GitHub repositories with distinct development workflows and testing conventions, and may benefit from different harness configurations. Second, harness optimization is expensive and much of the information generated during this process is ultimately underutilized. During optimization, the system accumulates a rich history of candidate harnesses and evidence about which strategies succeed or fail under different conditions. Existing methods use this experience to improve the global harness ( Lee et al., 2026b ; Lee et al., 2026a ; Sengupta and Wang, 2026 ) . Once optimization is complete, however, much of the instance-specific signal contained in this history is discarded. This leads to a fundamental question:
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究试图通过优化测试框架（harness）来自动化这一过程（Anthropic, 2025a；Lee et al., 2026b；Lee et al., 2026a）。 例如，Meta-Harness（Lee et al., 2026b）采用了一种外层循环的程序搜索方法：一个独立的智能体根据先前评估过的候选框架的执行轨迹提出新的测试框架；而Harness-R1（Shao et al., 2026）则通过强化学习（RL）训练一个“框架工程师”，将成批的智能体失败案例转化为可执行的运行时补丁。 尽管现有方法展现出潜力，但它们存在两个局限性。 首先，这些方法优化的是一个全局统一的测试框架，随后将其统一应用于所有或一批测试实例。 然而，对某个实例有效的测试框架，在另一个实例上可能并非最优。 例如，SWE-Bench风格的测试实例可能来自不同的GitHub仓库，这些仓库具有独特的开发流程与测试规范，因此可能需要不同的测试框架配置才能获得最佳效果。 其次，测试框架的优化成本高昂，且在此过程中生成的许多信息最终并未得到充分利用。 在优化过程中，系统会积累丰富的候选测试框架历史，以及关于不同策略在不同条件下成功或失败的相关证据。 现有方法利用这些经验来改进全局测试框架（Lee et al., 2026b；Lee et al., 2026a；Sengupta and Wang, 2026）。 然而，一旦优化完成，这段历史中所包含的大量与特定实例相关的信息便会被丢弃。 这引出了一个根本性问题：

paragraphs.en: Can we adapt a globally optimized harness to each individual instance by reusing the experience accumulated during harness optimization?
paragraphs.zh: 我们能否通过复用在约束优化过程中积累的经验，将全局最优的约束适配到每个具体实例？

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we introduce Turbo Harness 1 1 1 We adopt the name “Turbo Harness” by analogy to a turbocharger, which recovers energy from exhaust gas and reuses it to improve engine performance. . It is a new harness optimization framework that reuses artifacts from a completed outer-loop harness search to adapt a globally optimized harness to individual task instances.

paragraphs.en: Specifically, we reuse the search archive produced during outer-loop optimization and summarize it into a structured playbook ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) . This playbook records both successful and unsuccessful harness-editing strategies, including the specific edits that lead to performance improvements and those that fail to do so. We then train a harness editor , an RL-fine-tuned open-source model responsible for adapting the global harness to each instance. At deployment time, the harness editor receives a test instance together with access to the playbook and proposes a patch to the globally optimized harness. The resulting instance-specific harness is then used by the main execution model, which can be any model, to solve the test instance. Figure 1 illustrates this instance-specific adaptation and shows its gains on Terminal-Bench-2.1.
paragraphs.zh: 具体来说，我们复用外层循环优化过程中生成的搜索存档，并将其总结为一份结构化的操作指南（Zhang et al., 2026c）。 该操作指南记录了成功和失败的约束编辑策略，包括能带来性能提升的具体编辑以及未能实现这一目标的编辑。 接着，我们训练一个约束编辑器——一个经过强化学习微调的开源模型，负责将全局约束适配到每个实例。 在部署时，约束编辑器会接收一个测试实例以及对操作指南的访问权限，并针对全局优化的约束提出一个补丁方案。 由此生成的特定于该实例的约束随后会被主执行模型使用（该模型可以是任何模型），以解决这个测试实例。 图1展示了这种针对具体实例的适配过程，并显示了其在 Terminal-Bench-2.1 上的性能提升。

paragraphs.en: Our framework offers three advantages. First, instance-adaptive harnessing provides more flexibility than a single global harness across all task instances, consistently improving task performance in our experiments. For example, on SWE-smith-MR, Turbo Harness improves pass rate from 50.7% to 64.0% with Claude Haiku 4.5 and from 70.7% to 88.0% with Gemini 3.7 Flash. Second, training the harness editor is lightweight: rather than generating a new harness from scratch, it only needs to patch a globally optimized harness, guided by a playbook that summarizes successful and unsuccessful edits from the outer-loop search. This allows us to use a relatively small editor model (Qwen3.5-9B in our experiments). Finally, Turbo Harness adds little inference-time overhead because the editor is called only once per instance; moreover, the adapted harness can often reduce the number of execution steps required by the much larger execution model, potentially even lowering overall inference-time compute (see e.g., Table 2 and 3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的框架具有三项优势。 首先，实例自适应的利用方式比适用于所有任务实例的单一全局利用方式更具灵活性，并在我们的实验中持续提升了任务性能。 例如，在 SWE-smith-MR 数据集上，使用 Claude Haiku 4.5 时，Turbo Harness 将通过率从 50.7% 提升至 64.0%；使用 Gemini 3.7 Flash 时，则从 70.7% 提升至 88.0%。 其次，训练利用编辑器所需的计算量很小：它无需从头生成新的利用方案，而只需在外部循环搜索中总结成功与失败的编辑操作所形成的指导方案引导下，对全局优化的利用方案进行局部修正。 这使得我们能够使用相对较小的编辑器模型（在我们的实验中为 Qwen3.5-9B）。 最后，Turbo Harness 几乎不会增加推理时的额外开销，因为每个实例只需调用一次编辑器；此外，经过自适应的利用方案通常能减少规模大得多的执行模型所需的执行步骤数，甚至可能降低整体的推理计算量（参见例如表 2 和表 3）。

paragraphs.en: We formulate instance-adaptive harness optimization and highlight the limitations of deploying a single globally optimized harness across all task instances.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将问题表述为实例自适应的约束优化问题，并指出了在所有任务实例中部署单一全局优化约束所带来的局限性。

paragraphs.en: We propose Turbo Harness, which reuses the artifacts collected during the outer-loop harness search to train a harness editor that adapts the global harness to each individual task instance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Turbo Harness，它重用了外层循环的 harness 搜索过程中收集到的产物，以训练一个 harness 编辑器，从而将全局 harness 适配到每个单独的任务实例。

paragraphs.en: We show that Turbo Harness is lightweight: the editor only patches a globally optimized harness, can be instantiated with a small model, and is invoked only once per task instance.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明了 Turbo Harness 具有轻量级特性：编辑器仅对全局优化的 harness 进行修补，可以用小型模型进行实例化，并且在每个任务实例中仅被调用一次。

paragraphs.en: We demonstrate that instance-specific harness adaptation consistently outperforms globally optimized harnesses across seven benchmarks spanning interactive agent tasks, software engineering, and long-horizon terminal tasks, while often reducing execution steps and costs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们证明，针对具体实例的 harness 自适应方法在涵盖交互式智能体任务、软件工程以及长期终端任务的七个基准测试中，始终优于全局优化的 harness，同时通常能减少执行步骤和成本。

paragraphs.en: Prompt and Context Optimization. A growing line of work improves frozen language models by optimizing their prompts or, more broadly, the information provided to them during inference ( Ramnath et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . For example, GEPA ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) evaluates execution trajectories to evolve prompt candidates via a Pareto-based search. ACE ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) accumulates and refines an evolving playbook of strategies through generation, reflection, and curation. MCE ( Ye et al., 2026 ) further expands this design space by co-evolving context-engineering skills and query-conditioned context functions, whose artifacts may include files and code. They primarily optimize the model’s context. Harness engineering, however, encompasses a broader design space: beyond deciding what information is presented to the model, it can modify the executable runtime itself, including control flow, tool-use workflows, permissions, and verification mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 提示与上下文优化。 越来越多的研究通过优化提示，或者更广泛地说，通过优化推理过程中提供给模型的信息，来改进固定语言模型（Ramnath 等人，2025；Li 等人，2025）。 例如，GEPA（Agrawal 等人，2026）通过基于帕累托的搜索评估执行轨迹，从而演化提示候选方案。 ACE（Zhang 等人，2026c）通过生成、反思和整理，积累并完善一个不断演变的策略方案库。 MCE（Ye 等人，2026）进一步扩展了这一设计空间：它通过协同演化上下文工程技能与查询条件化的上下文函数来实现，其产物可能包括文件和代码。 它们主要优化模型的上下文。 然而，工程利用涵盖了一个更广泛的设计空间：除了决定向模型呈现哪些信息外，它还可以修改可执行的运行时本身，包括控制流、工具使用流程、权限和验证机制。

paragraphs.en: Automatic Harness Optimization. Recent methods ( Sengupta and Wang, 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Pan et al., 2026 ; Park et al., 2026 ) optimize the agent scaffold itself. Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026b ) uses a strong external coding agent to search over executable harnesses by inspecting previous implementations, scores, and execution traces. Self-Harness ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) removes the stronger external proposer, allowing the target model to identify failure patterns, propose harness modifications, and validate them through testing. Both methods produce harnesses intended to generalize across a collection of instances. AutoDesign ( Luo et al., 2026 ) likewise applies meta-harness optimization to long-horizon agentic design tasks. Recursive Harness Self-Improvement ( Lee et al., 2026a ) performs lightweight optimization by representing the agent loop as a prompt-level object and repeatedly revising it using pairwise feedback from its revision history. Unlike them, our method introduces an instance-adaptive harness without requiring a new multi-round search for each instance. This strategy enables more flexibility, which translates into consistent performance gains in our experiments.

paragraphs.en: Adaptive Prompt and Harness Optimization. A related line of work studies prompt and harness optimization that tailors the resulting prompt or harness to individual task instances. For example, Advisor Models ( Asawa et al., 2025 ) trains an advisor model that enables instance-specific prompt optimization. TTHE ( Nie et al., 2026 ) performs harness search on unlabeled test batches and carries the selected program to subsequent batches. Harness-R1 ( Shao et al., 2026 ) trains a harness engineer from batches of failure trajectories and evaluates each candidate patch by rerunning the same tasks under the modified harness. A concurrent work JIT-Agent ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) also targets instance-specific harnesses, but generates each harness from scratch via teacher distillation and evolutionary RL. In contrast, Turbo Harness at deployment time introduces only a single additional call to a small model, avoiding the two-pass procedure required by Harness-R1 ( Shao et al., 2026 ) to first collect a failure trajectory and then rerun the task under the resulting patch. Moreover, Turbo Harness edits an existing global harness rather than synthesizing a new harness from scratch for each task instance.

paragraphs.en: Inner- and Outer-loop Optimization. A standard approach to optimizing Equation 1 is to organize search into an inner loop and an outer loop ( Lee et al., 2026b ; Lee et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . The inner loop evaluates a candidate harness by running the corresponding agent on a set of task instances and collecting feedback, including task scores, execution traces, tool outputs, and failures. The outer loop then uses this feedback to diagnose the current harness and propose an improved candidate. Repeating these stages yields an iterative search process in which agent executions provide the evidence used to update the harness.
paragraphs.zh: 内循环与外循环优化。 优化方程 1 的一种标准方法是将搜索组织为内循环和外循环（Lee et al., 2026b；Lee et al., 2026a；Zhang et al., 2026b）。 内循环通过在一组任务实例上运行相应的智能体并收集反馈来评估候选框架，反馈包括任务得分、执行轨迹、工具输出和失败情况。 外循环随后利用这些反馈诊断当前框架，并提出改进的候选方案。 重复这些阶段可产生一个迭代搜索过程，其中智能体的执行提供了用于更新框架的证据。

paragraphs.en: The outer-loop optimizer may range from a hand-designed update rule ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2024a ; Yuksekgonul et al., 2024 ) to an LLM-based agent that automatically modifies prompts, control logic, or the harness program itself ( Ursekar et al., 2026 ; Lee et al., 2026b ) . In the latter case, Meta-Harness ( Lee et al., 2026b ) , for example, uses a coding agent to search over harness programs by inspecting previous candidates, evaluation results, and execution traces. However, Meta-Harness produces a globally optimized harness that is applied across future task instances. This can be suboptimal when different instances benefit from different harness strategies. For example, a simple coding task can be solved by a lightweight edit-and-test loop, whereas a difficult task may require specialized tools or more extensive verification.

paragraphs.en: Harness Editor. Searching for an optimal harness independently for each task instance can be expensive, as it may require evaluating multiple candidate harnesses per instance. paragraphs.en: To further reduce training cost, we reuse the experience collected during outer-loop harness optimization. In particular, the search archive records the outcomes of all evaluated harnesses, including candidates discarded during search. Following ACE ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , we summarize these successes and failures into a playbook 𝒫 \mathcal{P} of editing strategies and the conditions under which they are useful. This way, the harness editor does not need to discover new strategies from scratch. It only needs to learn how to use the playbook and identify which previously discovered strategies are relevant to a given task instance. This strategy significantly reduces the training cost and enables the use of a small LLM.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步降低训练成本，我们重用了在外层循环的 harness 优化过程中收集到的经验。 具体来说，搜索档案记录了所有已评估 harness 的结果，包括在搜索过程中被舍弃的候选方案。 遵循 ACE（Zhang et al., 2026c）的方法，我们将这些成功与失败案例总结为一份编辑策略及其适用条件的 playbook 𝒫 \mathcal{P}。 这样一来，harness 编辑器就不需要从头开始探索新的策略了。 它只需学习如何运用这份 playbook，并识别哪些先前发现的策略适用于给定的任务实例即可。 这一策略显著降低了训练成本，并使得使用小型 LLM 成为可能。

paragraphs.en: Benchmarks. We evaluate Turbo Harness on seven benchmarks spanning agentic tasks, software engineering, and long-horizon terminal interaction. For the four agentic benchmarks, ALFWorld ( Shridhar et al., 2020 ) , ScienceWorld ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , DBBench ( Liu et al., 2024 ) , and WebShop ( Yao et al., 2022a ) , we report success rate, mean environment score in [ 0,100 ] [0,100] , accuracy, and Success@1, respectively. For software engineering, we use SWE-smith-MR , our multi-repository subset of SWE-smith ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , and SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . On both coding benchmarks, pass rate is the fraction of test issues resolved by explicitly submitted code patches, with unsubmitted attempts counted as failures. paragraphs.en: SWE-smith-MR. On SWE-smith-MR, instance-specific adaptation produces large gains with both execution models (Table 2 ): Turbo Harness raises the pass rate from 50.7 % 50.7\% to 64.0 % 64.0\% with Haiku and from 70.7 % 70.7\% to 88.0 % 88.0\% with Gemini, improvements of 13.3 13.3 and 17.3 17.3 percentage points over Meta-Harness. The remaining baselines isolate the harness as the operative lever: averaged across both coding benchmarks, reflective prompt optimization (GEPA) ( Agrawal et al., 2026 ) and context engineering (ACE) ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) improve over Default but do not reach Meta-Harness ( 45.9 45.9 and 44.3 44.3 versus 54.1 54.1 ), let alone Turbo Harness ( 66.4 66.4 ). A single global harness thus leaves substantial headroom across issues from different repositories, even under a fixed execution model, and adapting the harness per instance recovers much of it.

paragraphs.en: SWE-bench Verified. The same pattern holds on SWE-bench Verified, a second coding benchmark drawn from real-world GitHub issues, where Turbo Harness again outperforms or matches Meta-Harness. With Gemini, the pass rate rises from 38.4 % 38.4\% to 54.4 % 54.4\% ; with Haiku, it rises from 56.7 % 56.7\% to 59.3 % 59.3\% , a smaller 2.7 2.7 -point improvement. paragraphs.en: We observe that Turbo Harness lies on the accuracy-cost Pareto frontier. The lightweight OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) harness is the cheapest overall ($0.85 per task, 54.4 54.4 turns, 1.55 1.55 M input tokens) but also the least accurate ( 47.3 % 47.3\% ), spending little because it attempts less. Every harness that is competitive on pass rate costs more, yet Turbo Harness is at once the most accurate and the cheapest among them: relative to Meta-Harness it cuts turns per task from 76.3 76.3 to 71.2 71.2 , cost from $1.56 to $1.38, and input tokens from 3.15 3.15 M to 2.65 2.65 M, and it likewise undercuts the other competitive harnesses, Terminus-Kira and Terminus-2. Per-instance adaptation thus buys higher accuracy while trimming cost, whereas the heavier global and default harnesses spend more for less.

paragraphs.en: We next study what enables Turbo Harness to improve over the globally optimized harness. We focus on two questions: whether RL and the recycled playbook are both necessary, and how the editor model’s capability and RL training affect the ability to leverage the playbook.

paragraphs.en: RL and the playbook are complementary. We first isolate the contributions of RL and playbook conditioning using the same Qwen3.5-9B editor on SWE-smith-MR with a frozen Haiku 4.5 executor (Figure 3 Left). The globally optimized Meta-Harness achieves a pass rate of 50.7%. Introducing an untrained 9B editor without the playbook yields 51.3%, while providing the same editor with the playbook gives 50.0%. Likewise, an RL-trained editor without the playbook reaches only 49.3%. In contrast, combining RL training with playbook conditioning raises the pass rate to 64.0%, a 14.7-point improvement over the same RL-trained editor without the playbook. Thus, for the lightweight editor, neither generic per-instance editing, access to the playbook alone, nor RL alone explains the gain. The improvement emerges when RL trains the editor to identify and apply useful strategies distilled from the outer-loop search.

paragraphs.en: We introduced Turbo Harness, an instance-adaptive harness optimization framework that reuses experience from a completed global harness search. Turbo Harness summarizes this search experience into a playbook and trains a lightweight editor to adapt the global harness to each instance. Across our experiments, these instance-specific adaptations consistently outperform the corresponding global harness. Moreover, it provides more flexibility, which we find often translates into lower execution costs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Turbo Harness，这是一个能够适应具体实例的约束优化框架，它可复用已完成的全局约束搜索中的经验。 Turbo Harness 将这种搜索经验总结为一份策略手册，并训练一个轻量级编辑器，以针对每个实例调整全局约束。 在我们的各项实验中，这些针对具体实例的调整始终优于对应的全局约束方案。 此外，它还提供了更高的灵活性，我们发现这通常能带来更低的执行成本。

sents.en: We introduced Turbo Harness, an instance-adaptive harness optimization framework that reuses experience from a completed global harness search.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 Turbo Harness，这是一个能够适应具体实例的约束优化框架，它可复用已完成的全局约束搜索中的经验。

sents.en: Turbo Harness summarizes this search experience into a playbook and trains a lightweight editor to adapt the global harness to each instance.
sents.zh: Turbo Harness 将这种搜索经验总结为一份策略手册，并训练一个轻量级编辑器，以针对每个实例调整全局约束。

sents.en: Across our experiments, these instance-specific adaptations consistently outperform the corresponding global harness.
sents.zh: 在我们的各项实验中，这些针对具体实例的调整始终优于对应的全局约束方案。

sents.en: Moreover, it provides more flexibility, which we find often translates into lower execution costs.
sents.zh: 此外，它还提供了更高的灵活性，我们发现这通常能带来更低的执行成本。

paragraphs.en: Our method has two main limitations. First, Turbo Harness builds on a completed global harness search, so its effectiveness depends on the quality and diversity of the harness candidates, trajectories, and feedback collected during that process. If the original search explores only weak strategies or provides limited useful experience, the gains from instance-specific adaptation may also be limited. Second, training the harness editor requires additional environment rollouts. This can be costly on agentic tasks. Future work could reduce this training cost through more sample-efficient optimization or reuse of existing rollout data, and investigate whether editors and playbooks can transfer across tasks, domains, or harness-search runs. More broadly, Turbo Harness suggests that the intermediate artifacts produced during harness optimization can serve as reusable experience rather than disposable byproducts.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法存在两个主要局限性。 首先，Turbo Harness 基于已完成的全局 harness 搜索构建而成，因此其有效性取决于在此过程中收集到的 harness 候选项、轨迹和反馈的质量与多样性。 如果原始搜索仅探索了较弱的策略，或仅提供有限的有效经验，那么通过针对具体实例进行自适应所获得的收益也可能受到限制。 其次，训练 harness 编辑器需要额外的环境运行。 在智能体任务中，这可能会产生高昂的成本。 未来的研究可以通过更高效利用样本的优化方法，或复用现有的运行数据来降低这一训练成本，并进一步探究编辑器和 playbook 是否可以在不同任务、领域或 harness 搜索运行之间迁移使用。 更广泛地说，Turbo Harness 表明，在 harness 优化过程中产生的中间产物可以被视为可重用的经验，而非一次性副产品。

paragraphs.en: SWE-smith-MR design rationale. We construct this subset to evaluate instance-specific adaptation across issues with potentially different execution requirements. The selected repositories span web frameworks, data processing, developer tools, and other Python projects, whose project structures and testing conventions may call for different exploration and validation strategies. This motivates our hypothesis that a single global harness can make tradeoffs across repositories that instance-specific adaptation can help resolve. Sampling the same number of issues from each repository gives each repository equal weight in the evaluation, while holding out issues within these repositories tests adaptation to new issues.

sents.en: Construction proceeds in three offline stages.
sents.zh: 构建过程分为三个离线阶段进行。

paragraphs.en: First, extraction assembles one experience record per training instance from the search archive, without any model calls. Each record collects the per-harness outcomes and full execution traces recorded during search and classifies the instance as contrastive (some harness variant solved it while another failed), uniformly solved , or uniformly unsolved . For contrastive instances, we additionally pair the most dissimilar solving and failing variants and compute the source-level diff between them, which localizes the harness change responsible for the differing outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，提取过程从搜索存档中为每个训练实例组装一条经验记录，且无需任何模型调用。 每条记录都会收集每次测试框架在搜索过程中记录的结果和完整的执行轨迹，并将该实例分类为对比性实例（某个测试框架变体成功解决了问题，而另一个则失败）、统一解决或统一未解决。 对于对比性实例，我们还会将最不相同的成功解决变体和失败变体进行配对，并计算它们之间的源代码级别差异，从而定位导致结果不同的测试框架变更。

paragraphs.en: Second, reflection uses a frontier model to analyze each record and emit a short structured reflection: the salient instance characteristics, the behavioral difference between the harness variants, a candidate editing strategy, a rationale, and a confidence score. Contrastive records are analyzed against both traces and the harness diff, whereas uniform records are analyzed to explain why the outcome did not depend on the harness. Reflections that name known anti-patterns or fall below a confidence threshold are discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，反思过程会利用一个前沿模型来分析每条记录，并生成一段简短的结构化反思内容：关键实例特征、不同 harness 变体之间的行为差异、候选编辑策略、推理依据以及置信度分数。 对比性记录会与追踪信息和 harness 差异一同进行分析，而统一性记录则用于解释为何结果不依赖于 harness。 若反思中提及已知的反模式或置信度低于阈值，则会被舍弃。

paragraphs.en: Third, curation consolidates the surviving reflections into the playbook with a single frontier-model call. Semantically equivalent strategies are clustered into one canonical entry that merges their applicability conditions and aggregates helpful and harmful evidence counts and confidence; strategies whose evidence is net-harmful become anti-patterns , and vague or over-specified strategies are filtered out. Each retained entry records the condition under which it applies, the strategy text, its evidence and confidence, and a type tag distinguishing edits to the scaffold’s control flow ( scaffold_modification ) from edits to the information shown to the model ( text_injection ). The result is a compact list of conditional strategies together with a list of anti-patterns and a few general notes; for example, the TB2.1 playbook comprises six strategies and nine anti-patterns. At both training and inference time, the entire playbook is placed in the editor’s context, so the editor learns which previously discovered strategies are relevant to each instance rather than retrieving them.

paragraphs.en: Coding execution. Both coding benchmarks use the mini-swe-agent scaffold ( Yang et al., 2024b ) in Docker, with a limit of 40 40 execution-model steps and a $3 cost limit per issue. Only explicitly submitted code patches are evaluated for issue resolution, and the pass-rate denominator includes every test issue. For Turbo Harness, we generate one adapted harness per issue and reuse it across the three execution runs. We compute each run’s pass rate, mean steps, and mean execution-model cost over the complete test set, then report the mean and sample standard deviation divided by 3 \sqrt{3} across runs. The Verified subset and execution budget differ from full-benchmark leaderboard settings, so our absolute rates should not be read as leaderboard results.
paragraphs.zh: 编码执行。 两项编码基准测试均在 Docker 中使用 mini-swe-agent 框架（Yang et al., 2024b），执行模型步数上限为 40，每个问题的成本上限为 3 美元。 仅对明确提交的代码补丁进行问题解决评估，而通过率的分母则包含所有测试问题。 对于 Turbo Harness，我们为每个问题生成一个适配的测试框架，并在三次执行运行中重复使用它。 我们计算每次运行在整个测试集上的通过率、平均步数以及执行模型的平均成本，然后报告各次运行结果的平均值和除以 3 \sqrt{3} 后的样本标准差。 Verified 子集和执行预算与完整基准测试的排行榜设置不同，因此不应将我们的绝对比率视为排行榜结果。

paragraphs.en: Prompt-based variants. This distinguishes the ReAct row from the zero-shot Default. Self-Refine adds a proposal–critique–revision cycle before executing an action. Reflection runs an initial episode and, if it is not fully successful, generates a verbal reflection to guide a second episode. It reports the better outcome across the two attempts, whereas Default and Turbo Harness each use a single execution rollout. These variants therefore differ in both interaction strategy and model-call budget.

paragraphs.en: Harness-R1 comparison. We evaluate the released Harness-R1 checkpoint in its AgentBench runtime on our ALFWorld and DBBench test splits, because we could not reconstruct its exact evaluation sets from the public release. For WebShop, we use the authors’ reported result on the same seed- 233 233 , 200 200 -goal test set. Because ScienceWorld is not one of Harness-R1’s benchmarks, we port its code-hook method into the same runtime as a new task and RL-train the released engineer on ScienceWorld with our optimizer; the reported value ( 28.2 28.2 ) is this RL-trained engineer, and the zero-shot released checkpoint scores comparably ( 29.7 29.7 ). Harness-R1 uses an initial rollout followed by a patched rerun, whereas Turbo Harness proposes its patch before a single execution rollout. The comparison therefore uses different runtimes and rollout budgets; it does not isolate the effect of the harness editor alone.
paragraphs.zh: Harness-R1 对比。 我们在自己的 ALFWorld 和 DBBench 测试分片上，于 AgentBench 运行时环境中评估了已发布的 Harness-R1 检查点，因为我们无法从公开版本中重建其确切的评估数据集。 对于 WebShop，我们使用了作者在相同种子值 233 233、200 200-目标测试集上报告的结果。 由于 ScienceWorld 并非 Harness-R1 的基准测试之一，我们将它的代码挂钩方法移植到相同的运行时环境中作为新任务，并使用我们的优化器对已发布的工程师模型在 ScienceWorld 上进行强化学习训练；所报告的值（28.2 28.2）即为此经过强化学习训练的工程师模型的成绩，而零样本的已发布检查点得分也表现相当（29.7 29.7）。 Harness-R1 采用初始执行后接修正重运行的方式，而 Turbo Harness 则在一次执行运行之前提出其修正方案。 因此，该对比使用了不同的运行时环境和执行预算；它并未单独隔离 harness 编辑器本身所带来的影响。

paragraphs.en: Repeated-execution reliability. On SWE-smith-MR, Turbo Harness increases the number of issues resolved in all three runs (Figure 4 ). This count rises from 20 20 to 28 28 out of 50 50 issues with Haiku and from 26 26 to 42 42 with Gemini. At the same time, the number resolved in only one or two runs falls from 11 11 to 10 10 and from 18 18 to 3 3 , respectively. Thus, the higher mean pass rates are accompanied by more consistently solved issues, especially with Gemini. This analysis measures execution consistency for fixed per-instance harnesses; it does not measure variability in editor training or harness generation.
paragraphs.zh: 重复执行可靠性。 在 SWE-smith-MR 上，Turbo Harness 在所有三次运行中解决了更多问题（图 4）。 使用 Haiku 时，这一数字从 50 个问题中的 20 个上升到 28 个；使用 Gemini 时则从 26 个上升到 42 个。 与此同时，仅在一两次运行中解决的问题数量分别从 11 个降至 10 个，以及从 18 个降至 3 个。 因此，更高的平均通过率伴随着问题解决的更一致性，尤其是在使用 Gemini 时。 此分析衡量的是固定单次实例 Harness 的执行一致性；它并未衡量编辑器训练或 Harness 生成中的变异性。
